generator_cmd: bash smc_gen.sh data_lcg   # gcc + python3 stdlib (struct/zlib) blob writer + python3 post-link xor patch (readelf -sW symbol range)
oracle_cmd: bash smc_oracle.sh data_lcg   # runs the program natively (it self-decrypts and prints the blob; python3 zlib.crc32/json check), readelf -SW / -sW / -lW + objdump -d of a python3-decrypted copy for offsets
note: gcc -O2 PIE; raw blob in a read-only .cfgx section under an LCG keystream (k = k*0x6d+0x3b, seed 0x91; not a repeating xor), mprotect(RW) + in-place decrypt + fwrite; offset = .cfgx file offset
